hotels.title: Family-Friendly Orlando Escape with Daily Drinks, Included Resort Fees & Walt Disney World® Resort Shuttle
hotels.description: Adventure and magic await at this family-friendly _Walt Disney World Good Neighbor_® Meliá stay, located just minutes from the world-famous _Walt Disney World®_. With packages for up to six guests and a prime position in the village of Celebration - with palm-lined streets, charming boutiques and inviting restaurants all laid out according to The Walt Disney Company's original specifications - you'll be perfectly placed to experience all the action, with complimentary shuttles to Walt Disney World®, Universal Orlando™, _SeaWorld Orlando™_ and more. When you're not exploring the parks, spend time lazing by the resort's lagoon-style heated pool, sink into bliss at the nearby AdventHealth Wellness Center & Spa (access included), build an appetite up at the onsite volleyball net by the pool area or feast on coastal cuisine at The Wilson.
